title: C.I.E.B The Backrooms
description:
Welcome to CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE EXPERIMENTAL BRANCH. 

A new world needs to be explored and our world does not know you exist. Your perfect.

We were in control of a very teensy tiny bit of the backrooms. Our information and data were left behind during the Flicker. We need you to bring it back to us. 

If you want something to buy then research it. Once we can replicate it, we will sell it back to you. 

Do not falter if things dont make sense. Very little is known of this world but disorder and fear.
description_short: You were abducted by a organization lead by the C.I.A. They have your son and see you as a mule to explore a world beyond ours. The Backrooms. Now you must explore, collect and build up your LAB to collect a profit. They promised you freedom if you help them. Can you trust them?
